name: tokenis
description: Aggregate questions over confidential data without exposing a single record: encrypted columns, admission control against differencing attacks, and a signed audit trail. Leave the config empty to try it on built-in fictional data.

config_file.title: Tokenis config (tokenis.toml)
config_file.description: Your dataset and policy (see examples/tokenis.toml in the repository). Leave empty to use the built-in fictional demo data.

tokenizer_key.title: Tokenizer key
tokenizer_key.description: 64 hex characters from `tokenis-mcp keygen-secret` (only needed with a config file). Keep it stable: it defines every token.

audit_key.title: Audit-trail signing key
audit_key.description: 64 hex characters from `tokenis-mcp keygen-secret`, if your config sets [state] audit_key_env = "TOKENIS_AUDIT_KEY".
